name: auth_extended_features
note: client_features 2147483649 is FEATURE_TOPOLOGY (0x1) plus FEATURE_EXTENDED (0x8000_0000), which says client_features_hi is present and that this client reads server_features_hi. client_features_hi 1 is bit 32 of the feature set. A decoder that predates the extended word ignores the field and still reads client_features as a u32.
